name: bpm-platform
description: BPM — business process management platform (NestJS API + React web UI)

scripts.install:all: (cd bpm-api && npm ci) && (cd material-kit-react && npm ci)
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix bpm-api && npm run lint --prefix material-kit-react
scripts.api:restart: npm run api:build && systemctl restart bpm-api.service
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run api:restart && npx --yes pm2@5 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env || npx --yes pm2@5 restart bpm-web
